intent: Repair source-confirmed gateway and MCP connection reliability gaps identified by diagnostic capture 8597579 while preserving selected-profile identity, verified transport proofs, TLS, bounded retries and existing supervisors.
ownership: data/agent/tool MCP connection and catalogue code

implementation: Preserve typed MCP error codes and retryability in connection health.
Classify nested TLS failures before generic handshake or timeout messages and pause MCP automatic discovery until explicit reconnect.
Do not count a wrapped local cooldown/preflight rejection as a new physical transport failure.
Qualify the existing singleflight and durable journal paths with a bounded 48-job disconnect/reload soak.
